quest.title: A Short Encounter with a Rare Bird
quest.description: You bumped into a Forest Ranger, Shefket, who's carrying out ecological research in Sumeru's forests, and he told you about his Dusk Bird research. Can he really capture a Dusk Bird?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.speaker: Shefket
dialogues.text: Hey, you over there! The one who just hunted that wild boar with mushrooms on its back... Can you come over here? I have something to discuss with you!
Oh, I'm really sorry if I'm bothering you, but I have something to discuss...
Can I have a piece of that Shroomboar you just hunted?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shroomboar... That wild boar with mushrooms on its back?
Yup, exactly. They're always rolling in the mud of Sumeru, so spores stick to their fur and grow into mushrooms.
Haha, some say the mushrooms gradually eat away at the wild boar while they grow... Likewise, the Shroomboar's meat gains a unique mushroom aroma, and becomes expensive...

response.text: Haha! It's just a rumor. Shroomboars can eat the mushrooms on each other's backs during the winter or when they have nothing to eat.
Mushrooms, on the other hand, can spread their spores even further with the wild boars carrying them... It's actually a healthy symbiotic relationship...

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: Ooh, forgive me, I don't think I've introduced myself. I'm Shefket, and you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This is Paimon!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: #I'm {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: #So, {NICKNAME} and Paimon, got it. I knew you weren't ordinary when I saw how swift-footed you were while hunting that Shroomboar...

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: Actually, I'm carrying out research on wild animals, but... *sigh* I can't capture those Shroomboars.

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: They either run or ram me to the ground as soon as I get close... If this goes on, my waist is going to give way before I even start my research...

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: So, when I saw how easily you took down a Shroomboar, I had to try and ask if I could purchase some of its meat.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is there something special about it? It looks just like the meat from any other wild boar...

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: Oh my, of course we have to carry out an investigation to find out the differences! Sell it to me. I'll pay you well.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Give the Shroomboar meat to him...)

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: Oh, thank you so much! I can carry on with my research now!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Just what kind of research is Shefket carrying out?

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: It's just some ordinary ecological surveys. Sometimes, I capture animals and research their growth...

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: Just a single animal can tell me things about the recent growth of its entire colony. It's really quite miraculous...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon can tell how much you love animals, Shefket!

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: Yes, I... I've always loved them. I've spent so much time studying them. The ecology in the forests of Sumeru is absolutely fascinating...

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: Alright, I've got the Shroomboar meat. I need a Dusk Bird next.

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, have you seen a Dusk Bird before? It's a gorgeous bird found in the <color=#00E1FFFF>south of Apam Woods</color>.

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: It's a bird unique to Sumeru. Even the Akademiya researchers often use it to send messages... Though it's capable of long distance travel, it hates rain and will hide away on rainy days.

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: Well, it's time for me to go. A Dusk Bird... I hope I'll be able to capture one on my own... Haha, I can't keep relying on others.

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: But if you're willing... Ahem... I hope you'll keep an eye out for me. I'm willing to buy the Dusk Birds you capture.

talks.objective: Hunt Dusk Birds in the south of Apam Woods

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, you're that field researcher!

dialogues.speaker: Shefket
dialogues.text: What do you mean? Haha, my name is Shefket. We've met before. You even sold some Shroomboar meat to me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup! He paid us much higher than the price of ordinary wild boar meat...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, Shefket, what are you doing here?

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: Hahaha! It's embarrassing to say, but my research is still ongoing...

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: I need a Dusk Bird, but I still haven't caught one... My research progress is worrying... And that's not the worst.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's not the worst?

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: I even encountered the Eremites. They raised their weapons at me on sight...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, so the Eremites mistook us for you...

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: Huh? Did they? Guess that's because... That's definitely because they don't understand that I'm trying to protect the Dusk Birds...

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: You see, I'm sure the Eremites here think of the Dusk Birds as their own property. That's why they're against me collecting a specimen for research.

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: After all, the feathers of a Dusk Bird are quite expensive...

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: Right, do you know that the Dusk Birds grow multicolored feathers as camouflage in the forest?

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: But in the end, many hunt them for those same gorgeous, multicolored feathers. It's really sad.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh no...

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: I don't have the courage to face the Eremites like you... *sigh*

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: Right, can you sell me a feather from the Dusk Bird you hunted?

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: Just like before, I'll compensate you generously!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Give the Dusk Bird feather to him...)

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: Haha, I've got a Dusk Bird feather too... Now, I'm more than halfway done with my investigation.

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: But this feather...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's wrong? Is there something wrong with it?

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: No, there isn't. Its quality just isn't very good... Oh, I mean, I can discern that the Dusk Birds in this area don't seem to be growing very well.

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: Well, I'll have to go around and gather more feathers. It's the only way I can find out what happened to the entire colony of Dusk Birds...

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: I heard there's a different colony of Dusk Birds in the <color=#00E1FFFF>north of Apam Woods</color>. It looks like I'll have to look for Dusk Birds there...

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: #Hmm, time to leave now! May we meet again, {NICKNAME} and Paimon!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yes, Paimon remembers now! It's the animal lover, Shefket!

talks.objective: Hunt Dusk Birds in the north of Apam Woods

dialogues.speaker: Orhan
dialogues.text: Stop it! Stop it! Why are you hunting Dusk Birds here again!?

dialogues.speaker: Orhan
dialogues.text: I get it now! You're the poachers who've been hunting here! And you're poaching my Dusk Birds again!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph! These Dusk Birds don't belong to you! You didn't raise them, did you?

dialogues.speaker: Orhan
dialogues.text: I didn't, but... They are my Dusk Birds because I say so.

dialogues.speaker: Orhan
dialogues.text: I'm in charge of protecting them!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're in charge of protecting them?

dialogues.speaker: Orhan
dialogues.text: Yes, I'm Orhan. I'm under orders from the Corps of Thirty to protect the Dusk Bird colony from poachers!

dialogues.speaker: Orhan
dialogues.text: You don't believe me? Take a look at these Orders signed by the Corps of Thirty's Sheriff.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Orhan shows you the Orders. It is signed by the Corps of Thirty.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? But that's not what we heard... Isn't an ecological survey being carried out on Dusk Birds?

dialogues.speaker: Orhan
dialogues.text: There's no such thing...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Did Shefket deceive us?

dialogues.speaker: Orhan
dialogues.text: Shefket... Shefket again... Oh, Dendro Archon! You've been utterly duped by that guy.

dialogues.speaker: Orhan
dialogues.text: He disguises himself as a Forest Ranger to trick people, but he's actually working with the Treasure Hoarders to sell the precious materials he gathers from rare animals...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How could that be...

response.speaker: Orhan
response.text: You're not the first adventurer to be tricked by him. He's always making adventurers help him and hiding behind them. He's as slippery as an eel...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #What do we do, {NICKNAME}? We've hunted quite a few Dusk Birds...

choices.text: Let's hope they serve balanced meals in prison...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: NOOOO! Paimon doesn't want to get locked up by the Corps of Thirty!

response.speaker: Orhan
response.text: ...It's not that serious. The Dusk Bird colony is quite huge, so Dusk Birds are not that rare. You didn't know what you were doing either, so it's not serious enough to get locked up for that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon gets it...

response.speaker: Orhan
response.text: But you can't escape being punished for it... I want to say that, but... Ahem, there's an opportunity for you to redeem yourselves!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: An opportunity to redeem ourselves?

response.speaker: Orhan
response.text: Yes, I don't know why, but Shefket seems to need a large amount of Dusk Bird feathers... We can use that as bait...

response.speaker: Orhan
response.text: For example, we can spread the word that there's a large group of Dusk Birds resting on the mountain at the <color=#00E1FFFF>east of Apam Woods</color>. He'll definitely take the bait.

response.speaker: Orhan
response.text: But he's a cunning guy, so even the slightest action we take will scare him off. That's where both of you come in!

response.speaker: Orhan
response.text: #Hmm... I think I heard the {F#blonde}{M#blond} one's name is {NICKNAME}. What about the flying one?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This is Paimon.

response.speaker: Orhan
response.text: #Oh, {NICKNAME} and Paimon. I need you to make contact with Shefket.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon gets it. He'll let his guard down with us...

response.speaker: Orhan
response.text: Exactly. We'll set up an ambush, so it'll be up to you to keep him busy.

response.speaker: Orhan
response.text: Once you meet him... Alright, just shout "We know everything you've done!" as the signal, and we'll get him!

response.speaker: Orhan
response.text: What do you think?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: No problem.

response.speaker: Orhan
response.text: Let's do it! Let's spread the news right now. Leave Sumeru City to me. Ferit, you take Gandharva Ville, and use this opportunity to find out if anyone's colluding with the Treasure Hoarders.

response.speaker: Orhan
response.text: Pamuk, around Vimara Village...

response.speaker: Pamuk
response.text: Got it, Boss! Don't worry, I'll spread the fake information!

response.speaker: Orhan
response.text: Alright, we're gonna get that poacher this time!

response.speaker: Orhan
response.text: #I'll leave the rest to you, {NICKNAME}. We must draw him out of hiding.

choices.text: Is it too late for us to flee from Sumeru?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It can't be helped. We'll have to return another time for the parts of Sumeru we haven't explored yet.

response.speaker: Orhan
response.text: I can't just watch as you flee right in front of me, and the Corps of Thirty has surrounded the area to combat the recent rise in poaching!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Nooo, I don't want to get locked up by the Corps of Thirty!

response.speaker: Orhan
response.text: ...Calm down. The Dusk Bird colony is quite huge, so Dusk Birds are not that rare. You didn't know what you were doing either, so it's not serious enough to get locked up for that.

talks.objective: Hunt Dusk Birds on the mountains east of Apam Woods

dialogues.speaker: Shefket
dialogues.text: #Oh? If it isn't {NICKNAME} and Paimon! I'm sure you're here because you've heard about the Dusk Bird colony resting here.

dialogues.speaker: Shefket
dialogues.text: This isn't an environment the Dusk Birds usually favor, so why would they come here? Perhaps it's something worth studying.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shefket...

dialogues.speaker: Shefket
dialogues.text: Haha, what is it? Oh, I'm sure you want to know if I'm still buying Dusk Bird feathers, right? Of course I am, their feathers are very precious.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "We know everything you've done!"

dialogues.speaker: Shefket
dialogues.text: Why did you say that? Do you suddenly feel proud of me for conducting such a hard research?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #(Huh? What's going on? Why haven't the Eremites come? We had an agreement with Orhan... {NICKNAME}, maybe Paimon should give it a try.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "We know everything you've done!"

dialogues.speaker: Shefket
dialogues.text: Paimon too? Oh my, it's alright. It's my duty, and you've helped me so much already.

dialogues.speaker: Shefket
dialogues.text: The process may be difficult, but it's all for a cause. It's for the animals of the forest...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It isn't for the animals! It's all for yourself!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We know everything you've done!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Orhan rushes out of the forest just as you finish speaking...

dialogues.speaker: Orhan
dialogues.text: Yes, Shefket, the Corps of Thirty is officially placing you under arrest for the crimes of impersonating a Forest Ranger, instigating unknowing adventurers to carry out poaching, and colluding with Treasure Hoarders!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Orhan, what took you so long? We almost lost our voices shouting the signal just now!

dialogues.speaker: Orhan
dialogues.text: Uh... We had a little accident...

dialogues.speaker: Shefket
dialogues.text: What's the Corps of Thirty doing here? What signal?

dialogues.speaker: Shefket
dialogues.text: "We know everything you've done!" So that's what you meant. I even felt a little touched just now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Liar!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just surrender!

dialogues.speaker: Shefket
dialogues.text: Ugh, I should have known you were with the Corps of Thirty... Hmph! The news about a Dusk Bird colony here was your doing too, right?

dialogues.speaker: Orhan
dialogues.text: Exactly. You've fallen into a trap, Shefket. I bet a veteran con man like you never expected to get conned yourself! The Corps of Thirty will treat you really, really well!

dialogues.speaker: Shefket
dialogues.text: *sigh* I guess there's no point trying to deny it. I'm very fond of the animals in Sumeru, but sometimes, just fondness is useless.

dialogues.speaker: Shefket
dialogues.text: I couldn't get into the Akademiya. All I could do was some meaningless surveys. In the end, others only thought of me as a weirdo wandering the forest.

dialogues.speaker: Shefket
dialogues.text: I need Mora... Not just for my research, but so that I can shut the mouths of those people who talk behind my back...

dialogues.speaker: Orhan
dialogues.text: So you started targeting the animals you knew best? Hmph! You caused greater losses just because you understand them! Isn't that something!

dialogues.speaker: Shefket
dialogues.text: I had no other choice...

dialogues.speaker: Orhan
dialogues.text: Stop trying to talk your way out of it! I will never believe your lies!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The liar has finally been apprehended.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, Orhan, what took you so long?

dialogues.speaker: Orhan
dialogues.text: Oh, that... Ferit and Pamuk never returned, and I couldn't find them. After much consideration, I decided to come here myself. Haha...

dialogues.speaker: Orhan
dialogues.text: Didn't I make it just in time? My timing was perfect.

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: Hmph! What? I expected many of the Corps of Thirty to be lying in ambush here. But it's just one?

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: I planned to feign capture and look for an opportunity to escape, but hah! It doesn't look necessary at all now!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh?

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: Don't tell me you think just the two of you and... a lousy guard from the Corps of Thirty can capture me?

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: Today's your unlucky day because it just happens to be the day I promised to deliver the goods to the Treasure Hoarders, so they're lying in ambush just over there. You're not the only one who can call for reinforcements!

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: Hurry! Get rid of them!

choices.text: Just a little later and it wouldn't have made a difference...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You make short work of the Treasure Hoarders.\nFerit and Pamuk arrive too...

dialogues.speaker: Ferit
dialogues.text: Boss!

dialogues.speaker: Pamuk
dialogues.text: Sorry we're a little late...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A little late? Everything's over...

dialogues.speaker: Ferit
dialogues.text: Oopsy...

dialogues.speaker: Orhan
dialogues.text: Where on earth did you two go!? I couldn't even find you... Whoa! You reek of alcohol...

dialogues.speaker: Ferit
dialogues.text: Hehe... But the best way to spread information has always been pretending to be drunk...

dialogues.speaker: Pamuk
dialogues.text: And then divulging the false information.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're 100 percent drunk...

dialogues.speaker: Orhan
dialogues.text: #*sigh* If it wasn't for {NICKNAME}, I would have gotten a good beating from the Treasure Hoarders.

dialogues.speaker: Orhan
dialogues.text: #I must admit, I wasn't expecting {NICKNAME} to take the Treasure Hoarders down so easily...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Of course! {NICKNAME} is stronger than {M#he}{F#she} looks!

dialogues.speaker: Orhan
dialogues.text: No wonder. I mean, I got taken out with great ease when I tried to stop you earlier, but this... exceeded my expectations a little.

response.speaker: Orhan
response.text: #Alright, Shefket. We... I mean {NICKNAME} has taken down the Treasure Hoarders you were relying on. Now, do you have anything else to say?

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: I—I... Actually, the mental trauma I experienced as a child is the cause of all this...

response.speaker: Shefket
response.text: Let me explain... It happened when I was just a young boy...

response.speaker: Orhan
response.text: Alright, you've caught this guy and atoned for your crimes. Next time, choose wisely when you decide to believe someone!

response.speaker: Orhan
response.text: If only you listened to me from the very beginning...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! You attacked us without saying a word!

response.speaker: Orhan
response.text: I admit... I do that when I get anxious. I guess I should try to be calmer next time.

response.speaker: Orhan
response.text: But I hope there isn't a next time. Be careful, and don't just believe anyone...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Got it, got it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon'll bear that in mind.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Orhan leaves with Shefket in his custody...

choices.text: It's going to get to my head if you don't stop!
